Mira Patel: Quick follow-up to the continuous-batcher RFC. Two open choices: queue decomposition (per-tenant micro-queues vs shared lanes) and when to pick kernels (admission vs post-coalesce). Need a rollout-friendly decision.
Kyle Park: My vote: shared lanes for utilization, but add a per-tenant soft-credit ledger to limit long-tailed borrowers. Keep micro-queues as a safety demotion.
Lena Ortiz: Agreed. In sims shared lanes netted better GPU packing. We saw oscillation when credits were unlimited. Recommend borrow caps and a decay replenish.
Omar Khan: Kernel timing: hybrid. Precompile the top 3 shapes we see in prod and mark batches as precompiled at admission. Everything else goes to a dynamic path that may incur a compile penalty.
Mira Patel: So combined plan: shared lanes + soft-credit ledger + hybrid kernel set. Canary: dynamic kernels disabled by default; opt-in per-tenant. Telemetry gates control ramp.
Kyle Park: Metric suggestions: borrow_rate (borrowed / allowed), credit_debt_pct, kernel_miss_rate, p99_latency_ratio. Automate damping: if borrow_rate > 0.2 for 2m, reduce coalesce window (eg 8ms -> 3ms) on affected hosts.
Lena Ortiz: Add cooldown 45s and exponential backoff to avoid flapping. Provide ops command to force demotion: /ops cb-demote-tenant <tenant>.
Omar Khan: Precompiled set start: {seq64_b8, seq128_b4, seq256_b2}. If kernel_miss_rate > 5% sustained 1h, auto-suggest additional shapes for precompile. Track first_compile_ms and alert if > 150ms median.
Mira Patel: Owners/ETA: Kyle - ledger + borrow metric (3d). Lena - oscillation detector + damping (4d). Omar - precompiled selector + telemetry (4d). Jon (cc) - dashboards + canary flag (1d).
infra-bot: Canary cluster request created: cb-hybrid-small. Feature flag cb.hybrid=true. Deploy ticket https://go/redwood/deploys/CB-HYBRID-SMALL-3778
Mira Patel: Rollout plan: 1% -> 5% traffic if p99 <= baseline*1.2 and fairness skew <=12%. Rollback triggers: sustained p99 > baseline*1.3 for 10m or fairness skew > 20% for 10m.
Kyle Park: I'll add unit tests for ledger invariants and a chaos test where one tenant spikes to ensure borrow damping fires.
Lena Ortiz: I'll draft a short runbook section for the RFC follow-up PR.
Mira Patel: OK to merge this plan into the RFC follow-up and tag owners? :thumbsup:
Kyle Park: ack
Lena Ortiz: ack
Omar Khan: ack
infra-bot: Canary cluster cb-hybrid-small scheduled for 2026-04-05 01:30 UTC.
